title: CT-AK cold-frame reconstruction refinement: final evaluation protocol (frozen before any final evidence)

frozen.renderer: WL111 frozen ECRO stack unchanged (engine_r111 admission G0; learned table d7e40954...; LOW = E1 + E2, HIGH = HL, TOTAL = LOW + HIGH)
frozen.R3: WL105 R3 checkpoint d51b6919... (8 x 8 online guides), executed as one CUDA graph (WL111 R3Graph)
frozen.S111: WL111 CT-AK checkpoints cand_r0 088b9936... / cand_r1 7166e236..., sub-4 online guides, S-mode CUDA graph (no history)
frozen.S111A: recon_r111a.FullResNet(1.0) trained by train_r111a.py S111A mixed 4 ri --net fullres --seed 17950021 + ri (Stage C declaration), final weights; sub-4 online guides; S-mode CUDA graph (no history)

host.device: LabServer70 RTX 3080 Ti (owner assignment 2026-11-27); quality and timing on this device unless the owner reassigns; every record states the device
host.container: WL111 frozen-stack container (lab70/ctr_r111a.sh), no CPU cap
host.guard: guard_r111.py --gpu-uuid <3080 Ti>: 120 s idle before start; any foreign compute process on the device stops and later restarts the step

seeds.structure: base + i0 * 100000 + i1 * 1000 + i2 (i0 < 10, i1 < 100, i2 < 1000), launched by WL111 launch_seed (splitmix64)

arms.S111_r0 / S111_r1: frozen WL111 CT-AK spatial (matched mechanism control: identical training contract, one full-resolution 3 x 3 layer)

views.historical_refs: WL107 historical references (eval_r111._ref_for); historical-workload comparison, not untouched generalization
views.sealed_new_rule: cameras105.random_cameras(candidates 200, seed sealed_camera_seed, cfg0 geometry, forbidden = every WL105 camera and K1-K6); accepted in order with WL111's geometry-only rule (2 x 2 valid fraction >= 0.9 and >= 2000 full-sphere pixels at 8 x 8) until six are accepted; references 32 x 8192 spp (ref_new family)
views.decision_set: sealed = K1-K6 + N1-N6 (12 views); historical reported separately

states.E_cfg1: WL111 Q3_cfg1_l0: boxes moved to WL100 test-1 geometry (rigid edit; = WL110 S1)

edited_states.references: WL111 T_ECRO references of these states (Q3 / Q5: 32 x 8192 spp; Q4: 64 x 1024 spp)
edited_states.per_frame: every arm reconstructs cold current frames of the edited state after the renderer's own geometry / light update (set_state); no history exists in any arm
edited_states.qualification: a state qualifies iff (a) reference precision: relative RGB RMS SE of its reference mean <= 0.10 x R3's debiased primary RMSE at 4 spp on that state, and (b) resolved change: on stationary receivers (centre-ray shape not a box in either state, contact disk excluded) the relative RMS difference of TOTAL between the state's reference and the cfg0 / light-0 V0 reference is >= 1 % and >= 10 x the combined reference noise. Non-qualifying states are reported and excluded from the edited-state decision. The edited-state claim requires >= 4 qualifying states.

references.T_ECRO: primary: qualified expectation of the frozen renderer (as above)
references.T_PHYSICAL: descriptive only: WL110 REF_FULL (kmax 256, 2 x 32768 spp, halves h0 / h1) for V0 / H1 / H2 (cfg0), E_cfg1 (S1) and E_l1 (SL); transport-depth difference (T_PHYSICAL - T_ECRO) reported separately from reconstruction error
references.qualification_static: per decision view: relative RGB RMS SE of the reference mean <= 0.10 x R3's debiased primary RMSE at 4 spp and <= 0.30 x the smallest debiased primary RMSE of any arm entering a decision at that view; otherwise the view's decisions are INCONCLUSIVE (reported)

quality_protocol.frame: one cold frame per replicate: arms receive the identical current-frame component means of that seed (paired)
quality_protocol.metrics: WL111 frame_metrics (debiased relative HDR RMSE, signed luminance bias, silhouette / material-boundary gradient ratio and error) per ROI (primary, sss_interior, silhouette, material_boundary, control, contact separately), plus LOW and HIGH component debiased relative RMSE and per-pixel mean / variance over replicates (expectation-error and variance maps)
quality_protocol.execution: quality frames may be split over processes on the same device (correctness-preserving: each item is fully determined by its seed)

timing.device: the host device above, single process under the guard, no other WL111A process
timing.static: interleaved per spp: every arm (R0, R3, S111, S111A; one network per architecture) warms up, then each of 30 rounds times one complete current frame per arm in shuffled order: ECRO frame + online guide acquisition + reconstruction to resident HDR output, synchronized wall time
timing.edit: interleaved per spp: each timed frame first applies a geometry update alternating cfg0 <-> cfg1 (renderer set_state, timed inside E2E), then the frame, guides and reconstruction
timing.components: per arm: guide acquisition, reconstruction graph, ECRO frame, geometry update (medians)
timing.conditions: each block records load1, nvidia-smi clocks / power / temperature / throttle reasons before and after

decision.anchor: R3 at 4 spp (primary); R3 at 1 / 2 spp out-of-distribution diagnostics
decision.routes: WL111 analyze_r111.routes unchanged (route A: cheapest candidate point with primary RMSE ratio upper95 <= 1.05, E2E ratio <= 0.85 with upper95 < 1.0, decision ROIs silhouette / sss_interior / material_boundary ratio <= 1.05 and upper95 <= 1.10; route B: largest-spp candidate point within R3's E2E, D >= 0.10 with lower95 > 0 and ROIs noninferior); GM over views, two-level bootstrap
decision.mechanism: S111A vs S111 of the same index at 4 spp on the decision set: GM primary RMSE ratio with bootstrap 95 % interval
decision.absolute_contract_C: at the routed operating point (else 4 spp), each realization: |signed luminance bias| <= 1 % in primary, sss_interior, silhouette, material_boundary, control; silhouette gradient ratio in [0.8, 1.2]; silhouette and material_boundary RMSE ratio vs R3 upper95 <= 1.05

verdict.QUALITY_PERFORMANCE_SUPPORTED: route A or B passes in the static regime for both S111A realizations AND contract C passes for both
verdict.FRONTIER_GAIN_BUT_QUALITY_UNQUALIFIED: route A or B passes in the static regime for both realizations, contract C fails
verdict.PARTIAL_MECHANISM_SUPPORT: no static route for both realizations, but S111A improves on S111 for both realizations (mechanism ratio upper95 < 1.0 at 4 spp)
verdict.NOT_SUPPORTED: neither a static route for both realizations nor a mechanism improvement for both
verdict.INCONCLUSIVE: reference qualification fails for the decision set, a baseline identity fails, or timing exclusivity cannot be established
verdict.edited_states: reported separately with its own route result; no dynamic claim without >= 4 qualifying states

decision.stop: cost futility (Stage C): S111A camera-form subsystem >= 0.70 x R3 camera form or static reconstruction overhead > 4 ms on the timing device -> stop before final quality evidence
